summary: The creator reviews his top Washington, D.C. neighborhoods to consider when moving to the city, discussing their distinctive vibes, transit accessibility, housing styles, and downsides, covering Columbia Heights, Adams Morgan, Georgetown, U Street, Navy Yard, Dupont Circle, Logan Circle, Mount Vernon, The Wharf, NoMa, and an honorable mention for Capitol Hill.
